note: Canonical source of truth for traditional Chinese zodiac (Sheng Xiao) relationship claims used across this site. These are birth-year-branch-only relationships — a simplified layer of full BaZi (Four Pillars) analysis, which also considers month, day, and hour branches. No page on this site should assert a zodiac relationship (clash, harmony, harm, or triad) that contradicts these tables. Corrected 2026-09-20 after a factual error was found in the original 2027 Fire Goat build (Dog was wrongly cast as Goat's Liu Chong clash partner instead of Ox).

six_clashes.description: Liu Chong (六冲) — direct opposition, the most severe of the paired relationships. Each animal has exactly one Liu Chong partner, always the sign six positions away in the 12-year cycle.

six_harmonies.description: Liu He (六合) — the single best 1-on-1 pairing for each animal.

six_harms.description: Liu Hai (六害) — a milder negative relationship than Liu Chong; friction/harm rather than direct opposition.

san_he_triads.description: San He (三合) — harmony trios; each member of a triad shares an above-average, cooperative-fortune relationship with the other two.
